error_types.name: entity_substitution
error_types.cause: a name, place or brand replaced by a similar-sounding one

error_types.name: digit_confusion
error_types.cause: a digit or quantity heard as another

error_types.name: reference_id_corruption
error_types.cause: a character or digit inside an identifier changed or transposed

error_types.name: itn_error
error_types.cause: a number normalised into the wrong written form

error_types.name: phonetic_substitution
error_types.cause: a word replaced by one that sounds close

error_types.name: homophone_substitution
error_types.cause: a word replaced by a true homophone

error_types.name: negation_deletion
error_types.cause: a negation dropped, inverting the sentence

error_types.name: boundary_error
error_types.cause: word boundaries misplaced, merged or split

error_types.name: endpoint_truncation
error_types.cause: the recogniser closed the turn early and the tail is gone

error_types.name: onset_clipping
error_types.cause: the first word or two never made it, typically on barge-in

error_types.name: hallucinated_insertion
error_types.cause: fluent text produced from silence, noise or a pause

error_types.name: repetition_loop
error_types.cause: a phrase repeated by the decoder

error_types.name: crosstalk_insertion
error_types.cause: background speech transcribed as the caller

error_types.name: code_switch_misrecognition
error_types.cause: an English term forced into the native script or the reverse

error_types.name: language_id_flip
error_types.cause: the turn rendered in a neighbouring language's script or lexis

error_types.name: transliteration_drift
error_types.cause: native words emitted in Roman rather than the native script
